svg.text: For design understanding and early scope coordination only.
Detailed fixing, connection, and installation information is excluded.

foreignObject.div: The column shaft is the primary vertical element, manufactured as hollow GRC/GFRC casing sections assembled on site. Fluted, smooth, or textured surfaces are produced per project specification and drawing.
Column bases — comprising torus molding, plinth, and step profiles — are produced as GRC/GFRC components. Classical orders (Doric, Ionic, Corinthian) and custom profiles are available.

Capitals — Corinthian acanthus leaf, Ionic volute, Doric echinus, or custom — are produced with fine-detail GRC/GFRC casting. Each capital is engineered to transfer loads and provide visual authority.
Columns define vertical rhythm, frame entrances, and establish architectural hierarchy on building facades. Column spacing, scale, and order are coordinated to the overall facade composition.

svg.text: Column Shaft — vertical casing, fluted or smooth
Base Profile — torus, plinth, and step moldings
Capital Detail — classical or custom crown element
Entrance Framing Role — portal and portico scope
Vertical Rhythm — entablature and column spacing
Decorative Character — order, finish, and expression
DURRAKA FACTORY FOR INDUSTRY — GRC/GFRC MANUFACTURING
